# DeArrow logo attribution

Source: [DeArrow official repository – public/icons/logo.svg](https://github.com/ajayyy/DeArrow/blob/master/public/icons/logo.svg).

The original logo SVG is mirrored without modification as `docs/third-party/dearrow-logo.svg`. The bundled 128 × 128 PNG `TypeTypeTV/Assets.xcassets/DeArrowLogo.imageset/dearrow-logo.png` is a copy of the official `public/icons/logo-128.png` asset from the same project, without runtime downloads.

The [DeArrow project README](https://github.com/ajayyy/DeArrow#credit) credits the logo as based on Twemoji, licensed under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Attribution is retained here. DeArrow is a project by [Ajay Ramachandran / ajayyy](https://github.com/ajayyy/DeArrow), and this tvOS client is not affiliated with the logo's authors.

Changes to asset appearance: none. The app renders it at 18 points inside a tiny translucent background in the top-left corner of loaded DeArrow thumbnails.
